facts: New body contract has separate authorized task/activity descriptor and chunk pages; existing Web NativeActivityPort.readBody still returns legacy NativeActivity content and UI declares shortened remainder unavailable. New route existence alone is not host capability negotiation.

Each page holds at most four64KiB chunks. hasMore only means more chunks are currently received. A receiving descriptor may have hasMore=false and later acquire chunks; only complete proves full sealed material, not tool/task success.

Current Web loadBody caches a complete legacy body per ID and does not re-read if data exists. It validates displayed-page membership and uses per-pane generation/abort authority. Reusing this terminal cache branch for receiving data would freeze an incomplete result.

Current NativeBody pretty-prints complete JSON and renders one pre; projection structuredClones data. New8MiB bodies and16MiB attempt cap require a deliberate client/rendered-byte budget rather than assuming the old prefix display/cache has suitable cost.
consumerPlan: Keep current Activity plugin and per-pane owner. Add new read authority only after reviewed public client interface and fixed compatible center/host opt-in. Legacy and redacted content retain their honest unavailable/no-content behavior.

On explicit disclosure, request descriptor before chunks; unopened/hidden/inactive views perform zero new reads. Keep legacy prefix usable, and expose saved full material only when descriptor actually supports it.

Bind every page to task/attempt/activity/protocol/representation/declared bytes+digest. Client reader owns base64, contiguous index/offset, chunk digest and final length/hash validation; Web consumes its typed result/stream rather than creating a second codec.

Use streaming UTF8 decoding or a final verified byte decode because chunk boundaries are byte offsets and may divide a multibyte character. An intermediate page is not independent JSON and must not be parsed as complete material.

When receiving reaches its current tail, display still receiving, not complete; resume only via an explicit refresh or existing bounded activity invalidation. interrupted retains partial data with incomplete integrity status; legacy cannot promise a recoverable tail.

Cancel or stop future page admission on collapse, row/page/center change, plugin disable and session invalidation; late completions cannot publish into a new lease. Preserve loaded authorized data according to the existing offline policy and bound both per-pane and connection retained bytes.

Avoid repeatedly joining/decoding/pretty-printing the full growing body on each chunk. Use bounded text presentation and a separate explicit full-material action if needed; measure time/memory before choosing a threshold, do not invent performance claims.
